instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements with major airline partners (United, Delta, American, Alaska and others). SKYW bears fuel risk only on pro-rate operations.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase agreements. United, Delta, Alaska, American bear fuel risk for contracted flights. SKYW bears fuel risk on pro-rate (~3-4% of ASMs). Avg price $3.33/gal in 2014. No hedging program.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons purchased: 57,959 thousand gallons (fiscal year ended December 31, 2014) from Item 7 table. Note: SkyWest-purchased gallons only; partner-purchased fuel not included.
